subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should detached longwork final delivery be owned by the existing requester-session completionOwnerKey/delivery-state substrate, or should OpenClaw expose a public owner-mode contract such as work-thread-final or origin-bridge-final?
rationale: Current main has a partial internal ownership substrate, but the issue asks for a public delivery policy and cross-surface single-final invariant that can affect model tools, plugin hooks, persisted state, and channel delivery semantics.

options.title: Keep this issue canonical
options.body: Use this issue to decide the owner-mode contract and then ask for one focused PR with docs, migration/compatibility reasoning, and live or reduced end-to-end proof.

options.title: Narrow to existing substrate
options.body: Declare requester-session completion ownership the intended model and only file follow-up bugs for concrete paths where completionOwnerKey or delivery state fails.

options.title: Move to a broader delivery obligation thread
options.body: Treat this issue as a partial overlap and make a durable delivery-confirmation issue the canonical owner for the ledger/outbox invariant.

recommendation.title: Keep this issue canonical
recommendation.body: Use this issue to decide the owner-mode contract and then ask for one focused PR with docs, migration/compatibility reasoning, and live or reduced end-to-end proof.
